lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 7 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments; spacing is non-uniform, with the largest gap occurring between the first and second anterior lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Fragmented and abbreviated line segments observed on the posterior flank, failing to reach the ventral fringe line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: One primary high-contrast circular spot on the upper-posterior haunch; secondary cluster of 2-3 smaller, lower-contrast spots on the lower lateral flank.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature; horn vector initiates at a ~35-degree angle from the frontal bone, curving posteriorly and then medially at the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory tipping constitutes approximately 15-20% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron between the eyes; two distinct white spots on the lower mandible; bright ochre-orange coloration on all four lower limbs below the knee/hock.
